content.short: Your smart decentralized launchpad for minting, vesting, offering your tokens!
content.description: T Minus One (T-1) is a decentralized token launchpad on Cardano. It serves as an all-inclusive service for founding projects, providing services for token minting, initial sale, vesting, tokenomics, and more. The features are entirely governed through Smart Contracts, which removes a crucial component of risk for investors. The Smart Contracts verify that the sale is correctly implemented, vesting schedules are adhered to and liquidity is provided correctly on DEXs.
content.meta: Find out about T Minus One (T-1) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
